decisions.reason: The resin injection unit builds directly on the firm's plural-component dosing know-how, and dropping the sister unit B has concentrated learning and resources on it, although its absence from the website since 2020 adds some uncertainty.
Automatic airless guns sit at the core of the firm's spray application expertise and in-house manufacturing, so it can keep improving them from customer feedback.
The manual airless gun is a core accessory tied to the firm's pumps and customer base, so it stays easy to sustain and refine.
The air-assisted airless line extends existing spray know-how across several models that serve industrial coating customers well, though trimming individual models is possible.

The data logger relies on digital knowledge far from the firm's mechanical core, which makes it the hardest product to assimilate, but rising demand for coating documentation and service still justifies keeping it.
